title: Rhine Drought Drives Fuel Costs Up: Analyst Reaction (Podcast)
summary: Europe’s energy supply chains are running out of water. Weeks of heat and drought have pushed Rhine water levels to exceptional lows, restricting barge traffic and sending gasoil freight rates to record levels. That is adding pressure to an already tight market for gasoil, diesel, jet fuel and other middle distillates, while exposing refineries, chemical plants and industries that depend on the river for critical supplies.

title: US Challenger Report Shows 33,429 Job Cuts in July
summary: Kelsey Berro, fixed income portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, joined the discussion to analyze the latest US Challenger job cuts report. The segment focused on the implications of these job cuts for the broader economy and fixed income markets, providing insights into potential impacts on investment strategies amid evolving economic conditions.
